property_summary: For any non-empty target list and any caddress that has no code, C.transfer always reverts.
When caddress has no code, C.transfer always reverts for any non-empty target list.
For any single non-empty target list and any address with no code, C.transfer always reverts.
For any non-empty array of target addresses, if transfer succeeds then C must have returned true and every target call must have succeeded; if any target call fails, transfer must revert.

For any call to c.transfer with a non-empty target array, if it succeeds then the transfer function returns true and every inner call to caddress from from succeeds (so c.transfer must revert if any such inner call would fail).

For a single-target transfer from a caller-provided address to a fixed target, a successful call must return true and, when the target callee is the same as the caller-supplied target address, the target must receive the value (its balance changes accordingly); otherwise the call must revert.
For a single-target transfer with zero value, if c.transfer returns true then the target's balance is unchanged; otherwise the call must revert.
